DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お話の経験を広報担当にも紹介できますが、いかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: We can also introduce the experience you described to the publicity staff. Would you like that?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 相談のために話した内容です。広報に名前や写真が出るとは考えていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 相談内容の公開は想定していないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I told you about it for the consultation. I had not expected my name or photo to appear in publicity materials.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you had not expected the consultation details to be made public. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の段階では掲載は決まっていません。ご希望を確認してから担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Nothing has been decided about publication at this stage. We will check your wishes before informing the staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自分の相談は進めたいです。でも広報への紹介は、今は断ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 個別相談を続け広報紹介を断る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want to continue my own consultation. But for now, I decline an introduction to the publicity staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Continue the individual consultation and decline the publicity introduction. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。掲載を断ることと、個別相談をやめることは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. Declining publication and ending the individual consultation are separate matters.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。相談記録には必要な名前を書いても、広報には渡さないでほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 相談用の氏名を広報へ渡さないよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. Even if my name is necessary in the consultation records, I do not want it passed to the publicity staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask that your name used for the consultation not be given to the publicity staff. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 広報への紹介を希望しないと記録します。相談の担当が必要な情報はその範囲で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will record that you do not want an introduction to the publicity staff. The consultation staff will check necessary information only within that scope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。後で協力したくなった場合も、掲載条件を聞いてから決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 将来協力する際は条件確認後に決めたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. Even if I want to cooperate later, I would like to hear the publication conditions before deciding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that if you cooperate in future, you want to decide after checking the conditions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その際は担当へお申し出ください。公開する情報や確認方法を相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell the staff member if that happens. You can discuss what information would be published and how it would be checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。今日は個別相談だけを続け、広報紹介は希望しないと伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本日の同意範囲を再確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. Please tell them that today I want to continue only the individual consultation and do not want a publicity introduction.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Reconfirm the scope of today's consent. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのように記録しました。相談の用件へ戻りましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have recorded that. Let us return to the subject of your consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 説明はこちらの人形で行います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: We will explain using this model.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 人形のこちら側ですね。自分の左側だと思っていたので、右で行うと聞いて驚きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 人形の向きで処置側が違って見えたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: This side of the model, right? I thought it meant my left side, so I was surprised to hear that it would be on the right.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the model's orientation made the side for the procedure appear different. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 説明を見る位置で左右が逆に感じられることがあります。ご自身ではどちら側のご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Left and right can seem reversed depending on where you watch the explanation from. Which side of your own body are you asking about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私の左側です。人形の向きで判断せず、私の体の左を確認してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自身の左側を確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: My left side. Please confirm the left side of my body rather than judging by the model's orientation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask them to confirm your own left side. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かりました。担当が記録と部位を照合します。まだ処置は始めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. The staff member will compare the records with the body site. We will not begin the procedure yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。紙に書かれた左右の欄も、一緒に説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 紙の左右表記の説明も求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. Please also explain the left and right fields written on the paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for an explanation of the left and right markings on the paper too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当を呼んで、記録の表記と実際の部位を確認します。間違いだと決めず、まず照合しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will call the staff member and check the written record against the actual body site. Let us compare them first rather than assuming there is an error.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。私が向きを見間違えた可能性もあります。違って見えたことを伝えたかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分の見間違いの可能性を認める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I may have misread the orientation myself. I wanted to tell you that it looked different to me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the possibility that you misread it yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その疑問を担当へ伝えました。確認した内容を、ご本人にも聞き直していただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have passed your question to the staff member. We will also have you confirm again what has been checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。左側の相談であることと、説明の左右を確認してから同意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 部位と記録の確認後に同意すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will give my consent after confirming that my concern is on the left side and checking the left and right in the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will consent after checking the body site and record. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当がこちらで確認します。説明をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: The staff member will check here. Please wait for the explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お二人で相談されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you both be taking part in the consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 最初は友人と一緒で大丈夫です。でも一部は自分だけで話したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一部を同行者抜きで話したいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: At first, it is fine to have my friend with me. But there is a part I would like to discuss on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to discuss part of the matter without your companion. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 承知しました。どの時点で席を分けるか、ご希望がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Understood. Do you have a preference about when we should have you sit separately?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 詳しいメッセージの内容に入る前です。友人に嫌なことを言われたわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 席を分けるタイミングと理由を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Before we go into the detailed contents of the messages. It is not that my friend said anything unpleasant to me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain when you want to sit separately and why. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 理由を詳しく友人へ説明する必要はありません。ご本人と個別に確認する時間を設けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: You do not need to explain the reason in detail to your friend. We will arrange time to check things with you individually.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 助かります。私から「あなたを疑っている」と言う形にはしないでほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 疑いをかける表現にしないよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: That would help. Please do not present it as me saying, 'I suspect you.'
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask them not to word it as an accusation of suspicion. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご本人の相談内容を個別に伺うためと案内します。友人への連絡が必要なら後で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will explain that it is to hear your consultation details individually. If we need to contact your friend, we will check with you later.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。友人には待つ場所だけ伝え、相談の中身を後で勝手に共有しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 待機案内と相談内容の共有を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Please only tell my friend where to wait, and do not share the consultation details afterward without asking me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish waiting instructions from sharing consultation details. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お伝えしてよい範囲は、その都度ご本人に確認します。今から個別に伺いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check with you each time about what may be shared. Would you like to start the individual discussion now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。ここからは一人で話し、友人への説明が必要な部分は後で相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 個別相談開始と後の共有確認に同意する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please. I will talk alone from this point, and we can discuss later what needs to be explained to my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Agree to begin the private consultation and check later about sharing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では席をご案内します。お連れの方には待機場所をお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will show you to your seat. We will tell your companion where to wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 荷物のお問い合わせでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have an inquiry about a parcel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日送った箱に、説明書を入れ忘れました。途中で箱を開けて追加してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 発送済み箱への説明書追加を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I forgot to put the instruction sheet in the box I sent yesterday. Could you open the box on the way and add it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about adding an instruction sheet to a box already sent. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 発送後の荷物へ別の物を追加する扱いはできません。説明書は今お持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We cannot add another item to a parcel after it has been sent. Do you have the instruction sheet with you now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。この薄い紙だけです。箱の中身が使えないかもしれないので、早く送りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 追加物と急いで送る理由を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, it is just this thin sheet of paper. They might not be able to use the item in the box, so I want to send it quickly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain what you want to add and why you want to send it quickly. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では説明書を別に送る方法をご相談ください。元の荷物の受取人に、別便になると伝える必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then please discuss sending the instructions separately. You will need to tell the original parcel's recipient that they will arrive in a separate shipment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。元の箱が戻ってくるように頼むのでなく、この紙を別に送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 元荷物の返送でなく別送を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. Instead of asking for the original box to be returned, I will send this paper separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose separate shipping rather than returning the original parcel. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 紙の宛先と料金を確認しましょう。元の追跡番号は、この別便の番号ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check the paper's destination and postage. The original tracking number is not the number for this separate shipment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 相手には箱の番号と、説明書は別送だと分けて伝えます。紙には箱の商品名も書き添えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 番号と便を分け受取人に知らせると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will tell the recipient the box's number and separately explain that the instructions are being sent separately. I will also add the name of the product in the box to the paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will distinguish the numbers and shipments when telling the recipient. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受取人が何の説明書か分かるようにするのですね。内容を確認して封をしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: That will let the recipient know which item's instructions they are. Please check the contents and seal the envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認しました。説明書を別送し、箱には追加されないことを相手へ知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 説明書の別送と元箱への非追加を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked. I will send the instructions separately and tell the recipient that they will not be added to the box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm separate shipping of the instructions and that they will not be added to the original box. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、この封筒の差出しを受け付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will accept this envelope for posting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日はどのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to discuss today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 銀行の人だという電話で、安全のため別の口座へ全部移すよう言われました。本当ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 銀行を名乗る電話から資金移動を指示されたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Someone who said they were from the bank called and told me to move all my money to another account for safety. Is that genuine?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that a caller claiming to be from the bank instructed you to move money. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ振込は行っていませんか。お電話の相手に伝えた情報を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you not made the transfer yet? We will check what information you gave the caller.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。口座番号は話しましたが、暗証番号は伝えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 送金前で開示済み情報を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I gave my account number, but I did not give my PIN.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have not transferred money and identify what information you disclosed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: これ以上情報を伝えず、指示の口座へ送金しないでください。確認担当へつなぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please do not give any more information or transfer money to the account they specified. I will put you in touch with the verification staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。電話は今もつながっていますが、切ってよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 継続中の電話を切ってよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. The call is still connected. May I hang up?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may end the ongoing call. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通話を終了して、着信記録は残してください。こちらでは電話相手の指示を前提に手続きを進めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please end the call and keep the incoming call record. We will not proceed with a transaction based on the caller's instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 切りました。画面の番号と教えられた口座のメモを見せますが、相手が本当に銀行かは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 着信番号と相手の口座を不確かな情報として示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I hung up. I will show you the number on the screen and my note of the account I was given, but I do not know whether the caller was really from the bank.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Present the incoming number and the caller's account as unverified information. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できた事実としてお預かりします。必要な対応をご案内しますのでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will take the facts you have been able to confirm. Please wait while we explain the necessary response.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。振り込まず、伝えた情報と着信記録をもとに担当へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指示送金せず確認担当へ相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will not transfer money and will consult the staff member using the information I disclosed and the incoming call record.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not make the instructed transfer and will consult the verification staff. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当を呼びました。引き続きこちらで伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have called the staff member. We will continue listening here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご指定の商品は本日ありません。こちらなら同じ用途で使えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: The product you requested is unavailable today. This one can be used for the same purpose.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族から頼まれた物です。見た目は似ていますが、勝手に替えてよいか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族の依頼品を自己判断で替えられないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is something my family asked me to buy. It looks similar, but I do not know whether I can change it on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you cannot independently substitute the item your family requested. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの条件が必要か、お分かりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know which requirements matter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 細かい条件は聞いていません。商品名だけのメモなので、先に家族へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 必要条件を知らず本人へ確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I did not ask about the details. My note only has the product name, so I will check with my family first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you do not know the requirements and will check with the person who requested it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ではこちらの表示を見せて相談してください。元の商品との成分や容量の違いはこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then please show them this label and discuss it. Here are the differences in ingredients and volume from the original product.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 写真を送ります。棚の札だけでなく、商品の名称と表示も撮ってよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 判断に必要な商品表示の撮影を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will send a photo. May I photograph the product name and label as well as the shelf tag?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to photograph product information needed for the decision. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかのお客様が写らないようお願いします。確認中は商品を売場へ戻しておけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please avoid including other customers. You may leave the product on the sales floor while checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。会計の列へはまだ並ばず、売場で返事を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会計前に売場で返答を待つと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will not join the checkout queue yet; I will wait for a reply here on the sales floor.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait for a reply on the sales floor before checkout. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 返事が来てからお選びください。分からない表示があればご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please choose after receiving the reply. We can explain any label information you do not understand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族から、今回は替えずに見送ると返事が来ました。商品を戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族の判断を受け購入を見送る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: My family replied that we should not substitute it this time and should pass on buying it. I will put the product back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide not to buy based on your family's decision. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらでお戻しを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will check that it has been returned here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you going out to the beach?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。砂が付くので、ここで靴を脱いで置いておこうと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 海辺へ行くため通路へ靴を置きたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Since my shoes will get sandy, I was thinking of taking them off and leaving them here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to leave your shoes on the path to go to the beach. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この通路に靴を残すと、通行の妨げになります。靴はお持ちになってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Leaving shoes on this path obstructs people passing. Please take your shoes with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。帰りに足を洗える場所があれば、そこで履き替えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 帰りに足を洗い履き替える場所を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. If there is a place to wash my feet on the way back, I would like to put my shoes back on there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for a place to wash your feet and change footwear on the way back. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの水場は手洗い用です。足を洗える設備は、この出口にはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: This water point is for washing hands. There is no facility for washing feet at this exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それなら、持ってきたタオルで砂を落とします。ベンチの上に立って拭くのは避けた方がよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: タオル使用とベンチの扱いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: In that case, I will brush off the sand with the towel I brought. I should avoid standing on the bench to wipe my feet, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check about using your towel and how to use the bench. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。周囲を汚さず、通行の妨げにならない所で行ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Please do it somewhere you will not dirty the surroundings or obstruct people passing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 座って拭きます。砂の付いたタオルは袋に入れ、ここでは洗いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 砂付きタオルを持帰り水場で洗わないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will sit down to wipe my feet. I will put the sandy towel in a bag and not wash it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will take the sandy towel home and not wash it at the water point. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お願いします。持ち物を置いたまま海辺へ行かないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do. Do not leave your belongings behind when you go to the beach.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 靴も袋に入れて持って行きます。戻ってから砂を落とし、荷物を残さず帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 靴を持ち歩き荷物を残さないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will put my shoes in a bag and take them with me too. When I return, I will remove the sand and go home without leaving any belongings behind.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will carry your shoes and leave no belongings behind. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 足元に気をつけてお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12234-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please watch your step as you go.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの案内をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which information are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族へ運賃表を送りたいです。横の窓口も一緒に写真に入れると、場所が分かりやすいと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 運賃表を窓口と一緒に撮影したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to send the fare chart to my family. I thought including the counter next to it in the photo would make the location easier to understand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to photograph the fare chart together with the counter. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ほかのお客様や窓口の資料が写らない範囲でお願いします。何を家族に確認してもらう予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please keep other customers and documents at the counter out of the photo. What are you planning to ask your family to confirm?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 行き先です。似た駅名が二つあるので、表を見せて選んでもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族に似た二駅の選択を確認したいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: The destination. There are two similar station names, so I want to show them the chart and have them choose.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you want your family to choose between two stations with similar names. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 運賃表の表示だけを使いましょう。駅名が小さい場合は、候補を文字で書いて伝えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us use only the fare chart. If the station names are too small, you can write the possible names out and send them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。写真に二つの駅名を全部入れようとすると字が読めないので、名前も別に送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 写真では読めないため駅名も文字で送ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. If I try to fit both station names into the photo, the writing will be unreadable, so I will send the names separately too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will also send the station names in writing because the photo is unreadable. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どちらの駅も、名前を省略せず伝えてください。家族の返事が来るまでは購入を決めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please give both station names without abbreviating them. Do not decide what to buy until your family replies.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。窓口の書類は撮らず、表の写真と二つの正式な名前を送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 他人資料を撮らず正式名称で照会する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will not photograph the counter documents. I will send the chart photo and the two full official names.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not photograph other people's documents; ask using the official names. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要なら、選ばれた駅への経路も確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: If needed, we can also check the route to the station they choose.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族から一つ目の駅と返事が来ました。その駅の経路を確認してから券を買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族が選んだ駅の経路確認後に購入を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: My family replied that it is the first station. I will check the route to that station before buying a ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to buy after checking the route to the station your family chose. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの経路をご案内します。ご希望の駅名をもう一度照合しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will explain this route. Let us check the name of the station you want once more.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 説明を始めてもよろしいですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: あとで家で聞き直したいので、録音してよいですか。まだ始めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 説明部分の録音許可を事前に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to listen again at home later. May I record it? I have not started yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask permission in advance to record the explanation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 担当と確認します。ほかの来庁者の声が入らない場所で行えるかも確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check with the staff member. We also need to check whether we can do it somewhere other visitors' voices will not be recorded.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。全部を録る必要はありません。書類の記入説明だけ残せれば十分です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 必要範囲を記入説明に限定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I do not need to record everything. It is enough to keep just the explanation of how to fill in the documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Limit the requested recording to the form-filling explanation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当はその説明部分の録音に同意しました。個人情報の確認に入る時はいったん止めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff member has agreed to recording that part of the explanation. Please stop it when we begin checking personal information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。止めるタイミングを一言教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 停止タイミングの合図を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. Could you give me a quick cue when it is time to stop?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a cue about when to stop. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 切り替える前にお伝えします。録音中でも不明な点は聞き返してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will tell you before switching. Even while recording, please ask again about anything unclear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。録れているからといって、分からないまま返事はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 録音中も不明点を聞き返すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I will not give answers without understanding just because it is being recorded.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask about unclear points even while recording. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では記入説明を始めます。終わったら停止を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then we will begin explaining how to fill in the documents. Let us confirm that recording is stopped afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 録音を始めました。説明が終わったら止め、個人情報の話は録りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 録音開始と個人情報部分の停止を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have started recording. I will stop when the explanation ends and will not record the discussion of personal information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the start of recording and stopping for the personal-information part. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。説明終了時にお声がけします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will let you know when the explanation ends.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日のお会計はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Here is your bill for today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 思っていたより高いです。カードが使えるか聞く前に、何の費用か説明してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 支払方法より先に内訳説明を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is higher than I expected. Before asking whether I can use a card, could I have an explanation of what the charges are for?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for an itemized explanation before discussing payment methods. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 内訳を確認する担当へおつなぎします。どの部分が分かりませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will put you in touch with the person who checks the itemization. Which part do you not understand?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この検査の欄です。診察で受けた物の名前と違うので、同じ物か確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 検査名称の表記差を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: This test section. The name differs from what I had during the consultation, so I want to check whether it is the same thing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out a difference in how the test name is written. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表記の対応を担当が確認します。金額の変更を希望するというより、内容の説明ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff member will check how the names correspond. You want an explanation of the contents rather than a change in the amount, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。受けていないと決めているわけではありません。まず名称と内容を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未実施と断定せず内容確認が目的だと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I am not concluding that I did not have it. First, I would like to know the name and what it involves.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that your aim is to check the contents, not assert that the test was not performed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。説明の後、お支払い方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. After the explanation, we will tell you about payment methods.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。カードが使えなかった場合の方法も、説明後に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: カード以外の支払方法も後で尋ねたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. After the explanation, I would also like to ask about alternatives if I cannot use my card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you also want to ask later about payment methods other than a card. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。お会計はまだ完了していませんので、案内が終わるまでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Your payment is not completed yet, so please wait until the guidance is finished.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。内訳を確認してから、利用できる方法で支払いをします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 説明後に会計を行うと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will check the itemization and then pay using an available method.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will pay after the explanation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当を呼びました。こちらの明細をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12235-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have called the staff member. Please keep this itemized statement with you.
